nature_language: 当前位置上海。我和朋友计划去北京玩三天，预算6000元，市内交通主要使用地铁，开一间单床房。请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shanghai. My friend and I are planning to visit Beijing for three days with a budget of 6000 RMB. We will primarily use the subway for transportation within the city and plan to book a single-bed room. Could you provide me with a travel itinerary?
